general.notes: LS-SM311G-20I ordering grade: -40°C to +85°C with DDM. Other case-temperature grades in the same datasheet: Standard 0 to +70°C, Extended -20 to +85°C, Industrial -40 to +85°C. Receiver sensitivity, overload, LOS thresholds per Note 3: PRBS 2^7-1 test pattern @ 1250Mbps, BER ≤ 1×10^-12. Transmitter centre wavelength λc 1260–1360 nm; receiver centre wavelength λc 1260–1610 nm. Average output power Note 1: optical power launched into SMF. Max supply current Icc 300 mA (Recommended Operating Conditions); electrical power in watts not stated.
general.suggestions: Distinguish datasheet-wide temperature grades vs. part-number-specific fields (20C vs 20I). SMSR row has no numeric limits in the table.
